about.en: XPIN is the token of XPIN Network, a decentralised wireless (DePIN) project that sells global eSIM data plans and encrypted connectivity through a network of user-operated hardware. The token is a BEP-20 on BNB Smart Chain at 0xd955c9ba56fb1ab30e34766e252a97ccce3d31a6 and is used to pay for data plans and to reward node operators.
